summary: Full backend + frontend validation of iteration 7 (live NOWPayments crypto + 48h countdown banner on OrderConfirmation). All 10 pytest cases pass and all 6 UI scenarios (EN/FR countdown, EN/FR expired, live crypto instructions without DEMO badge, real BTC address/amount) pass end-to-end.
tests_executed: * NOWPayments LIVE checkout: no mock flag, real numeric payment_id (5152056123 sample), real BTC pay_address (bech32/legacy prefix), payment_status='waiting'
* Already-paid crypto order → payment_status='paid', np_status='finished' (no provider call, order status restored after)
* REGRESSION Interac checkout → variant stock decrements by qty
* Guest Interac checkout QC → /order/:id shows data-testid='payment-deadline-warning' with data-testid='payment-countdown' text '⏳ You have 47h 59min left to pay' (EN)
* Language toggle FR → countdown '⏳ Il vous reste 47 h 59 min pour payer'
* MongoDB backdate created_at -50h → EN 'Deadline expired — the order will be cancelled.' and FR 'Délai expiré — la commande sera annulée.'

* Crypto (nowpayments/btc) order confirmation UI: data-testid='crypto-instructions' does NOT render DEMO MODE badge, shows real deposit address (362C5Zn41QbTH5tBiBo2XvNcZ4H7FiKFLA) and pay_amount (0.00104038 BTC), countdown banner also present
critical_code_review_comments: OrderConfirmation.jsx line 16-20: order state is only fetched when !order; if payment_status changes server-side (e.g. NOWPayments finished), the /orders/:id refetch happens inside the 20s polling effect (line 62-80), so hiding the banner works — but the countdown effect (line 52-59) does NOT auto-clear when order flips to paid/cancelled unless dependency `order` reference changes. That's fine because setOrder is called with fresh, but worth noting.

Persistent React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — same as iter 6. Appears from Emergent devtool instrumentation on the checkout province <select>. Cosmetic in dev, verify absent in prod build.
Console: repeated 401 on /api/auth/me for guest pages (age-gate, catalog, product) — expected but noisy. Consider suppressing the request when no nordpep_token is present.

backend/.env: NOWPAYMENTS_API_KEY is declared twice (line 9 empty, line 17 real). Python-dotenv keeps the LAST value so live mode does work, but the duplicate is fragile — a future edit to line 9 could silently disable live mode. Consolidate to one declaration.
test_credentials: Guest checkout — no credentials required. Admin creds at /app/memory/test_credentials.md not used.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 5 test orders (2 UI + 3 backend + 1 curl). Restored variant stock for bpc-157-5mg back to pre-test value 89. No residual TEST_ orders in mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Countdown banner data-testid='payment-countdown' is inside the parent banner data-testid='payment-deadline-warning'. Countdown ticks every 30s; hours can be 47 or 48 depending on timing. Backdating created_at in mongo does NOT trigger auto-cancel until the hourly watchdog runs or backend restarts — safe to visually check the expired label without restarting. For crypto UI verification: real live mode is confirmed when data-testid='crypto-instructions' does NOT contain 'DEMO MODE'. Checkout uses data-testid='place-order-btn' (not 'checkout-submit') and 'payment-interac'/'payment-crypto' (not 'pay-interac'). Compliance checkboxes are ack-age/ack-research/ack-terms. Serial pytest run requires -n 0 override because /app/backend/pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope.
